country.name: Netherlands
country.regulator: Promotional games of chance (winacties) must follow the Kansspelautoriteit's Gedragscode Promotionele Kansspelen: free entry (at most normal postage/phone cost) and prize limits. Paid lotteries need a Ksa licence.
country.eligibility: Usually residents of the Netherlands aged 18+ (some include Belgium); check the actievoorwaarden.
tips: A genuine winactie names the organiser and has actievoorwaarden (terms).
'Free' lottery tickets (gratis lot) usually turn into a paid subscription – read the small print.
You never pay to claim a prize or give your bank details for 'verification'.
country.paid_note: Paid lotteries in the Netherlands need a Kansspelautoriteit licence
